run.procedureSummary: Feed: add the cycle's row to every chamber, PUPAL included, with no limit check. Carry forward: go through chambers 1 to 6 in order. If a chamber is over its limit, cap it at the limit and add the excess to the next chamber, so excess received counts when that chamber's turn comes. Excess from chamber 6 is discarded and counted as loss. State check: use the quantities after carry forward and each chamber's state as it entered the check, so each chamber is tested once per cycle. LARVAL with quantity >= upper mark becomes PUPAL. PUPAL with quantity <= lower mark becomes LARVAL. Every change is logged. Metabolise: use the states just set and work out every share from the quantities after the state check before moving anything. A LARVAL share is floor(q/4); it is burned off and counted as loss. A PUPAL share is floor(q/2); it moves to the chamber one position lower (i-1), and chamber 1's PUPAL share is discarded as loss. Limits are not applied here; any overfill waits for the next carry forward, and after cycle 5 nothing more happens to it. Moult: if the line total after metabolise is over 38 (strictly), each chamber keeps floor(q/2) and the rest is discarded as loss, with states unchanged. At 38 or under nothing happens. The arithmetic was done by a Python script at C:\Users\Jaket\AppData\Local\Temp\om\desk-250\sim.py.

openPoints.assumption: Chambers are processed one at a time from 1 to 6, so excess received from chamber i-1 is part of chamber i's total when chamber i is checked against its limit.

openPoints.point: Which quantities and states the state check uses
openPoints.assumption: Quantities after carry forward, tested once per chamber per cycle. A chamber that changes state is not tested again in the same cycle.
The state after this cycle's state check.
Each share is rounded down on its own (floor of q/4 or q/2), and all shares are worked out from the quantities before metabolise moves anything.
Toward the lower position (chamber i to chamber i-1), which fits chamber 1's share being discarded.
The line total is taken after metabolise and the moult fires only if it is strictly over 38. At exactly 38 (cycle 5) it does not fire.
Carry-forward excess discarded from chamber 6, LARVAL burn-off, chamber 1's PUPAL share, and the amounts removed by moults.

The moult did not fire in cycle 5 because the total was exactly 38, which is not over 38.
